notes.title: v1.1.0 Patch Notes - Steamdeck verified...?
notes.notes: I updated the credits menu to include the entire localization team as well as special thanks to a ton of awesome people, I fixed a few minor UI bugs, and hopefully, did the last thing to make the game fully Steamdeck Verified! Look out for that green check! :)

notes.title: v1.0.6 Patch Notes - Balancing & Bug Fixes IV
notes.notes:
This week, we thankfully just have a small but very important update/fix. Shout out to the community (🛰️) once again for reporting things!

Character Ability Updates

 Updated damage amount for Olly's octomines


Bug Fix

 Fi️xed the “Defeat enemies using octomines” objectives that weren’t being triggered ️️️🛰️

notes.title: v1.0.5 Patch Notes - Balancing & Bug Fixes III
notes.notes:
Just some small (and not so small) things this week! Shout out to the community (🛰️) for highlighting some important issues!

General Updates

 Asteroids no longer spawn a small random amount of stardust.


Weapon Updates

 Decreased the seeker bullet’s lifetime.


Bug Fixes

 Seeker now works properly during Roscoe’s Focus ability
 Save data fix (affects pre-1.0.2 players only) 🛰️
 Fixed biggie and bomber achievements 🛰️
 Fixed some objectives that were being incorrectly triggered 🛰️
 Fixed some text inaccuracies in the objectives and achievements

notes.title: v1.0.4 Patch Notes - Balancing & Bug Fixes II
notes.notes:
Hey! Glad you’re still here enjoying the game (or, welcome to the new folks)! Here are some tweaks and bug squishes for ya.

General:

 Fixed a hidden achievement. Encounter enough enemies and you’ll see…
 Tweaked the camera’s motion


Character Ability Updates:

 Slightly decreased Sasha’s cooldown
 Slightly decreased Gertie’s cooldown


Ship Updates:

 Slightly increased the Chunker’s top speed
 Slightly increased the Chunker’s energy 


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed some mission text that was not displaying properly
 Fixed the player ship’s exhaust when using Roscoe’s Focus ability.


Enjoy! Don't forget to drop a review if you're reading this and you haven't. It would be greatly appreciated!

notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch Notes - Balancing & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We’ve made it! This is the first big balancing patch! No matter how much playtesting you do, there’s always balancing to be done, and now, we know :). Thanks to everyone who has pointed out bugs and major imbalances in the gameplay 🙏🏽

General:

 Updated how ships handle turning to (hopefully) improve performance.

Character Ability Updates:

 Increased Sasha’s Blink cooldown
 Increased Gertie’s Charge cooldown
 Slightly increased Xander’s Shield cooldown
 Slightly increased Roscoe’s Focus cooldown
 Slightly decreased Olly’s Octomines cooldown

Weapons:

 Slightly decreased Seeker damage

Enemies:

 Slightly increased turn speed for the Biggie’s laser
 Slightly increased the laser damage

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed objective “Don’t shoot for [x] seconds” so that it doesn’t activate until the round has started.
 Minor fixes


P.S. My apologies for the download size, I have no idea what happened there. It takes up the same amount of space on your hard drive...🤷🏽‍♂️

notes.title: v1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you all for being patient with this release! Shout out to those who identified any issues - I appreciate you immensely. Here are the changes:


 Fixed the objective "Clear 1 wave without getting hit in a single round"
 Fixed broken Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese strings.
 Fixed(?) framerate issues
 Minor fixes
